purpose: Reviewed allowlist of every line by which the composed production Firestore Rules differ from what production main deploys. After the 2.1.0 deploy (main ae808444, ruleset b603ae60) the two are identical, so every hunk below is a reviewed change on top of live main (r89: Sacked, R89-SACKED; Rules headroom, R89-HEADROOM). Regenerate only with node tests/support/composed-production-rules.cjs --print-main-delta origin/main, then review every hunk.

hunks.why: r89 Sacked (Nik 2026-11-03): a manager may tick 'I was sacked' on Season Results (optional sacked:true, one encoding); any sacking ends the Showdown after that season, so the Terminal Progress records the sacked map, the next season's first Transfer War roulette mark is refused, and the close and career reads accept completedSeason = the seasons played. END SHOWDOWN can no longer end a Showdown early once a sacked season is accepted, whether or not Terminal Progress has recorded it: an active Showdown's END names the exact accepted count and the last accepted commit must have no sacking (Codex C3 + re-check).
